title: Price level
description: One record: one country's published price level for one reference year and one spending category, relative to a stated basis (EU27_2020 = 100, or US = 1). Voyager use: budget planner and Travel Ease cost guidance (how expensive a country is).

date.description: First day of the reference year (YYYY-01-01): the observation time of the series.

index.description: The price level exactly as published, on `basis`.

basis.description: `eu27_2020_100` = index, EU27 (2020 composition) = 100 (Eurostat); `us_1` = ratio of the PPP conversion factor to the market exchange rate, United States = 1 (World Bank).

category.description: Spending category the price level covers.

category_code.description: The publisher's own code of the category (e.g. a Eurostat `ppp_cat` code).

category_label.description: The publisher's own label of the category.

flags.description: The publisher's status flags on the value (e.g. "p" provisional, "e" estimated).

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
